name: Classic Dungeon
desc: A world bundle is a linkable PLACE. This one supplies the classic Angband-style dungeon: a BEGINNER dungeon whose default entry is level 1 (depth.start). A more dangerous top area can LINK to it and enter deeper -- any level in [start, max] (the entry depth is just the depth arg generation already takes). Rooms section = the room set + connections; sibling sections (monster spawns, terrain, level features) come later.

list.desc: A large room with regular pillars.
